title: HORUS Process Engine resolved task form, schema version 1
description: Response of GET /api/bpm/processes/v1/tasks/{id}/form. Either a form (a JSON Schema for the result, display hints and prefilled data) or a link to the host's own screen. The engine validates the result of :complete against the same schema (422 FORM_VALIDATION_FAILED).

schema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for the task result. Supported field types: string, integer, number, boolean, enum, date, date-time and the money object {currency, amount}.

data.description: Prefilled values from declared variables. Masked fields are returned as masked placeholders, never in clear.

link.description: Resolved link to the host's own screen; relative, or on an origin listed in tasks.form-link-origins.

labels.description: Per field, per locale, for example { "reason": { "en": "Reason", "vi": "Lý do" } }.
